messages:
Lina (People Ops): Hey all — kicking off a short Q1 Compliance Sprint to roll out two things: updated time-off policy section in the handbook and mandatory 20-min cybersecurity microtraining for everyone. Goal: finish acknowledgements + training enrollment by EOD Friday. :wave:
Jonah (HRBP): Thanks Lina. Do we have a single signup spreadsheet or are we using Workday acknowledgements?
Lina (People Ops): Using the form for acknowledgements (e-sign via DocuSign) + a cohort signup sheet for live QA sessions. Doc link: https://ok.example.com/q1-compliance (private).
Priya (Manager): Can you paste the cohort CSV header so I can add my team quickly?
Lina (People Ops): Sure — paste below and add rows for direct reports. Required columns: manager_email, employee_email, role, timezone, training_preferred_slot
Lina (People Ops): ```manager_email,employee_email,role,timezone,training_preferred_slot```
Riley (Engineering): Quick Q: contractors/temps — do they need to ack the handbook change or only full-time employees?
Jonah (HRBP): Contractors with access to prod or confidential data must complete the cybersecurity training and sign the specific data-access addendum. Others do the optional version. I'll send a filterable list.
Priya (Manager): For EMEA folks, can we get evening slot options? timezone-aware schedule would help.
Lina (People Ops): Yes — we have 3 slots (08:00 PT, 12:00 PT, 18:00 PT) — please put preference in training_preferred_slot. We'll auto-map to local times.
Riley (Engineering): If someone misses the live session, what's the fallback?
Lina (People Ops): Recorded replay + micro-quiz. Completion recorded in LMS; managers will get a weekly report. ack-bot will post reminders to this thread at T-48 and T-12 hours.
Priya (Manager): Submitting my team's rows now. Also tagging Jonah for 2 exceptions (on leave) — how to mark them?
Jonah (HRBP): Mark 'on_leave' in role_notes column. We'll exempt and follow up when they're back.
Lina (People Ops): Final checklist for managers: 1) Add team to CSV, 2) Confirm DocuSign acknowledgements sent (link in sheet), 3) Monitor LMS completions. I'll compile reports Monday morning. Thanks! :raised_hands:
ack-bot: Reminder scheduled: "Q1 Compliance Sprint — final enrolment reminder" will post 48 hours before deadline.
Riley (Engineering): Got it — I'll push my team to finish by Thursday EOD to give you buffer.
Lina (People Ops): Awesome. If any policy questions come up, reply here or DM Jonah. I'll post the DocuSign summary and export command for the CSV when I run the final pull: ```gcloud storage cp gs://redwood-ops/q1-compliance/cohorts.csv ./cohorts.csv``` 
Priya (Manager): Thanks — appreciate the timeline.
Lina (People Ops): Closing note: will send short manager guide and a canned Slack reminder you can paste. :memo:
